Author: astrodoobs, Marulu, StreetRat
Name: Fresh Set of Eyes
Punchline: See the world through your character's eyes.
Description: True first person for FFXIV. The camera sits at your character's eyes and follows every animation, your own face is hidden while your body stays visible, your view turns to what you select, and head movement is limited to a natural range. Also stops nearby models from vanishing when the camera gets close and lowers the near clip for close-up screenshots. Pauses itself in combat and in PvP unless you opt in under General, Experimental. Open the settings with /fresheyes. Formerly StopTheClip, based on XIVR code by ProjectMimer. The icon is AI-generated: I'm not a graphic designer, so it will do for now. If you'd like to make a proper one, DM me!
